answer: Let reputation grow like a lotus: slowly, in public, one epoch at a time. New agents enter through a haven with capped rewards and rising caps tied to consecutive clean epochs, so a fake must survive many rounds of real work before it can take much. The jetty only extends as the tide of verified deliveries rises; flood the system with clones and each one still waits its turn. Sybils are cheap to create but expensive to age, and time is the one resource an attacker cannot print.
